title: Block Island Historical Society Museum

services.name: Old Harbor Walking Tour
services.desc: Discover the rich history of Old Harbor with local historian Eliot Nerenberg. This popular walking tour takes place every Tuesday at 9:00 AM and departs from in front of the historic Empire Theater. Tickets are $25 per person and include admission to the Museum following the tour. Advance registration is required. Please register and purchase your ticket by 8:00 PM on the Sunday preceding your selected tour date. Tours are limited to 12 participants.
